cards.example_en: Dad works in the records section of the hospital.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸在医院的档案部门工作。

cards.example_en: Riders secure their bikes with a lock near the gate.
cards.example_zh: 骑车的人在大门附近用锁把自行车锁好。

cards.example_en: Security at the airport checked every bag carefully.
cards.example_zh: 机场的安保人员仔细检查了每一个包。

cards.example_en: I planted one bean seed in a cup by the window.
cards.example_zh: 我在窗边的杯子里种下了一颗豆子种子。

cards.example_en: Graduates often seek part-time work during the summer.
cards.example_zh: 毕业生常常在夏天寻求兼职工作。

cards.example_en: Seize the chance to speak English.
cards.example_zh: 抓住说英语的机会。

cards.example_en: We select fresh apples at the market on Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 星期六我们在市场挑选新鲜的苹果。

cards.example_en: The senior students organised the sports day stalls.
cards.example_zh: 高年级学生组织了运动会的摊位。

cards.example_en: My skin is sensitive and turns red in strong sun.
cards.example_zh: 我的皮肤很敏感，烈日下会变红。

cards.example_en: She is halfway through a series of mystery novels.
cards.example_zh: 那套推理小说她已经读了一半。

cards.example_en: In the story, the servant opened the gate.
cards.example_zh: 故事里仆人打开了大门。

cards.example_en: The morning training session finished just after noon.
cards.example_zh: 上午的训练课刚过中午就结束了。

cards.example_en: The hotel has a quiet setting beside a small lake.
cards.example_zh: 这家旅馆坐落在小湖旁边，环境很安静。

cards.example_en: The two teams must settle the argument after the game.
cards.example_zh: 两支队伍必须在比赛结束后解决这场争执。

cards.example_en: The severe cold forced us to wear two coats.
cards.example_zh: 严寒迫使我们穿上了两件外套。

cards.example_en: She can sew a button back on.
cards.example_zh: 她能把扣子缝回去。

cards.example_en: The application form asks for age, name, and sex.
cards.example_zh: 申请表上要填写年龄、姓名和性别。

cards.example_en: We sat in the shade of a tree.
cards.example_zh: 我们坐在树荫下。

cards.example_en: His shadow stretched across the path.
cards.example_zh: 他的影子拉在小路上。

cards.example_en: The river is shallow here.
cards.example_zh: 这里的河水很浅。

cards.example_en: That sharp knife belongs in the drawer, away from children.
cards.example_zh: 那把锋利的刀应该放在抽屉里，远离孩子。

cards.example_en: Dad likes to shave before he leaves for work.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸喜欢出门上班前先刮脸。

cards.example_en: Write your class number at the top of the sheet.
cards.example_zh: 把你的班级号写在这张纸的上方。

cards.example_en: They waited in a bus shelter.
cards.example_zh: 他们在公交候车亭里等。

cards.example_en: We felt a sudden shift in the wind before the storm.
cards.example_zh: 暴风雨来临前，我们感到风向突然变了。

cards.example_en: Waves broke on the shore.
cards.example_zh: 浪花拍在岸上。

cards.example_en: There is a shortage of clean water.
cards.example_zh: 清洁的水短缺。

cards.example_en: Snow on the rooftops made a lovely sight at dawn.
cards.example_zh: 黎明时分，屋顶上的雪构成一幅可爱的景象。

cards.example_en: There's no phone signal in the mountains.
cards.example_zh: 山上没有电话信号。

cards.example_en: There has been a significant increase in sales.
cards.example_zh: 销售额大幅增长。

cards.example_en: Silence filled the exam room.
cards.example_zh: 考场里一片寂静。

cards.example_en: I sincerely thank you for your help.
cards.example_zh: 我真诚地感谢你的帮助。

cards.example_en: The stone will sink in water.
cards.example_zh: 石头会沉入水中。

cards.example_en: Workers fenced off the building site beside the gym.
cards.example_zh: 工人们把体育馆旁边的建筑工地围了起来。

cards.example_en: He rides a skateboard to school.
cards.example_zh: 他滑滑板去上学。

cards.example_en: Too much sun at the beach burned my skin.
cards.example_zh: 在海边晒得太久，我的皮肤被晒伤了。

cards.example_en: Don't skip breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 不要不吃早餐。

cards.example_en: I felt sleepy during the warm afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 温暖的下午我感到困。

cards.example_en: She ate a slice of bread.
cards.example_zh: 她吃了一片面包。

cards.example_en: The children slide down the hill.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们从山上滑下来。

cards.example_en: The cup is slightly broken.
cards.example_zh: 杯子稍微破了一点。

cards.example_en: You might slip on the icy steps outside the dorm.
cards.example_zh: 你可能会在宿舍外结冰的台阶上滑倒。

cards.example_en: Smog covered the city in winter.
cards.example_zh: 冬天雾霾笼罩着城市。

cards.example_en: Cover your mouth when you sneeze.
cards.example_zh: 打喷嚏时捂住嘴。

cards.example_en: It was a snowy morning.
cards.example_zh: 那是一个下雪的早晨。

cards.example_en: They play soccer after school.
cards.example_zh: 他们放学后踢足球。

cards.example_en: The text discusses a socialist system.
cards.example_zh: 课文讨论一种社会主义制度。

cards.example_en: This free software helps me record my spoken English.
cards.example_zh: 这个免费软件能帮我录下自己说的英语。

cards.example_en: Solar energy can heat water.
cards.example_zh: 太阳能可以烧水。

cards.example_en: The solid table can hold a heavy stack of books.
cards.example_zh: 这张结实的桌子能放下厚厚一摞书。

word.example_en: This film is sensitive to bright light.
Please settle down and open your books.
Do not lose sight of the main idea.
At first sight the map looks simple.
word.example_zh: 乍一看，这张地图很简单。

word.example_en: You may catch sight of the tower from here.
word.example_zh: 你从这里可能一眼看见那座塔。
